introduction: Tennessee 211 provides free, confidential community-resource referrals. Specialist hours vary by location, so use the local contact-center links for current service information.
description: Tennessee 211 provides free, confidential community-resource referrals. Specialist hours vary by location, so use the local contact-center links for current service informatio

sections.who: You can ask for information without receiving another benefit. Each referred program sets eligibility for assistance.
sections.get: Specialists provide nearby provider contacts and help identify the type of service needed.
sections.docs:
• County or ZIP code.
  • Need and any urgent date.
  • Previous referral results.
sections.apply:
1. Call 211

    Use United Ways’ regional contact links if you need your local center.

  2. Explain the problem

    Describe the location and help sought even if you do not know the program name.

  3. Follow the referral

    Ask the provider about intake and available assistance.
sections.after: Return for alternatives if the service cannot help.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using TN 211 local services and hours. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Is every center open the same hours?
No. United Ways says hours vary by location.
Do I need to know the agency name?
No. Specialists can help identify a relevant service from the need you describe.
It provides referrals; the receiving program decides assistance.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
